Q: How to connect BSC wesocket provider with Web3J or Web3js A:

GetBlock currently (May 2021) doesn't support WebSocket provider.

From their pricing page:

Webhooks & WebSockets

Coming soon! We are constantly adding new features and upgrading the service

If HTTPS provider is sufficient to your use case (e.g. if you don't need to use the web3 subscriptions), you can use any provider that only supports HTTPS connection. Including GetBlock or the recommended providers stated in the BSC docs

Othwerwise, you'll need to use a different third-party provider that supports WebSockets or configure your own.

Q: Reading And Writing to MYSQL in AWS Glue A:

Please note that you have to provide a valid database URL, not a localhost. I believe your jupyter notebook was run locally on a laptop, in the same local environment where your mysql is running as well.

AWS Glue runs within an AWS environment, and behind the scene it would launch number of EC2 instances depending upon the DPU configuration. If your URL is configured as LOCALHOST, then the EC2 instance where the pyspark code is running, would look for a mysql database on the same node.

Please make sure you have a valid public IP for the mysql database, and try to setup a connection in the AWS Glue as suggested by bdcloud, and retry again. If you dont want to create a connection, you can hard code the connection parameters in the code and try again. If you cannot get a public IP for the installed mysql database, maybe you can try setup an RDS Mysql on AWS, and use it for testing.

Sample code snippet:

conn = mysql.connector.connect(host=url, user=uname, password=pwd, database=dbase)
cur = conn.cursor()

insertQry = "INSERT INTO emp (id, emp_name, dept, designation, address1, city, state, active_start_date, is_active) SELECT (SELECT coalesce(MAX(ID),0) + 1 FROM atlas.emp) id, tmp.emp_name, tmp.dept, tmp.designation, tmp.address1, tmp.city, tmp.state, tmp.active_start_date, tmp.is_active from EMP_STG tmp ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE dept=tmp.dept, designation=tmp.designation, address1=tmp.address1, city=tmp.city, state=tmp.state, active_start_date=tmp.active_start_date, is_active =tmp.is_active ;"

n = cur.execute(insertQry)
print (" CURSOR status :", n)

Q: How to send Body Data to GET Method Request Android A:

You can use retrofit to send request with body. http://square.github.io/retrofit/

It is easy to use library, example:

@GET("[url node]")
Single<Response<ResponseBody>> doSmt(@Header("Authorization") String token, @Body ListRequest name);

Also, take a look here about get methods with body HTTP GET with request body

UPDATE

GET method with request body is optional here. However, this RFC7231 document says,

sending a payload body on a GET request might cause some existing implementations to reject the request.

which means this isn't recommended. Use POST method to use request body.

Q: How to stash changes while keeping the changes in the working directory? (Git) A:

There's a trick may help you, not stash' thing but FWIW:

git commit -m "Your already staged content (May be empty)"   #(Commit index)
git add -A                    #(stage remaining 'unstaged' contents)
git commit -m "My works so far (Unstaged)" # (Working directory)
git tag stash                 # (mark the commit with 'stash' tag)
git reset HEAD^               # (1st reset (--mixed): Unstaged)
git reset --soft HEAD^        # (2nd reset (--soft): Staged (Skip if your index was empty))

And so now you have a commit tagged stash at your disposal, it's not possible to do a git stash pop anyway but you can do things like creating patch or resetting files etc from the created 'stash' tag, your working dir files are also left intact BTW.

If you prefer to store in a branch:

current_branch=`git branch --show-current`
git checkout -b stash             # (create and switch to new branch 'stash')
git commit -m "Your already staged content (May be empty)"   # (Commit index)
git add -A                        # (stage remaining 'unstaged' contents)
git commit -m "My works so far (Unstaged)"         # (Working directory)
git reset HEAD^                   # (1st reset (--mixed): Unstaged)
git reset --soft $current_branch  # (2nd reset (--soft): Staged)
git checkout $current_branch      # (Now go back to where you've left with your working dir and staged status intact)

Q: Change cell styles from one style to another A:

I had a similar need and adapted your script with some controls over the months. Style replacement is made only once per sheet (not per cell). Deleted style is made optional.

I don't know if it is possible to to know in advance whether a worksheet uses a style. Nevertheless we can check if the style exists in the workbook before checking every cell for it. Note that a style can be defined yet it may never be used.

Sub ReplaceCellStyleInWorkbook()
    Dim fromStyleName As String
    Dim toStyleName As String
    Dim nOccurrences As Long
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim cell As Range
    Dim rngWS As Range 'Holds one range containing many cells
    Dim boolStyleExists As Boolean
    Dim confirmationDialogAnswer As VbMsgBoxResult
    Dim collMatchingCellsWS As New Collection 'One cell range per worksheet

    fromStyleName = InputBox("Current value corresponds to selected cell", "Style to replace:", ActiveCell.Style)
    If StrPtr(fromStyleName) = 0 Then
        Debug.Print "User has cancelled"
    Else
    
        'Check if the the specified style name exists in the workbook
        boolStyleExists = False
        On Error Resume Next
        boolStyleExists = Len(ActiveWorkbook.Styles(fromStyleName).Name) > 0
        On Error GoTo 0
        If boolStyleExists = False Then
            MsgBox "The style " & fromStyleName & " does not exist in the active workbook"
        Else
            nOccurrences = 0
            For Each ws In ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets
                Set rngWS = Nothing
                For Each cell In ws.UsedRange
                    If cell.Style = fromStyleName Then
                        nOccurrences = nOccurrences + 1
                        If rngWS Is Nothing Then
                            Set rngWS = cell
                        Else
                            Set rngWS = Union(rngWS, cell)
                        End If
                    End If
                Next cell
                If Not rngWS Is Nothing Then
                    collMatchingCellsWS.Add rngWS, ws.Name 'Key is sheet name but not used later
                End If
            Next ws
            
            If nOccurrences = 0 Then
                MsgBox "No cell use this style name in the workbook!"
            Else
                toStyleName = InputBox("Enter the new style name to replace with", "New Style Name", fromStyleName)
                If StrPtr(toStyleName) = 0 Then
                    Debug.Print "User has cancelled"
                    Exit Sub
                End If
                
                'Check if the the specified style name exists in the workbook
                boolStyleExists = False
                On Error Resume Next
                boolStyleExists = Len(ActiveWorkbook.Styles(toStyleName).Name) > 0
                On Error GoTo 0
                If boolStyleExists = False Then
                    MsgBox "The style " & toStyleName & " does not exist in the active workbook. Cannot replace with it."
                Else
                    'Show the number of cells which will be impacted before proceeding.
                    confirmationDialogAnswer = MsgBox("Are You Sure? Number of occurrences: " & nOccurrences, vbYesNo)
                    If confirmationDialogAnswer = vbNo Then
                        Debug.Print "User has cancelled"
                    Else
                        Application.ScreenUpdating = False
                        'Replace all matching cells once per sheet
                        For Each rngWS In collMatchingCellsWS
                            rngWS.Style = toStyleName
                        Next rngWS
                        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
                    End If
                End If
            End If
    
            confirmationDialogAnswer = MsgBox("Would you like to delete " & fromStyleName & " style from the workbook?", vbYesNo)
            If confirmationDialogAnswer = vbYes Then
                ActiveWorkbook.Styles(fromStyleName).Delete
            End If
        End If
    End If
End Sub
